name: Soochow robot
full_name: Soochow University interventional surgical robot with catheter-tip thin-film force sensing
group: Soochow University, School of Optoelectronic Science and Engineering (Wei Wei, Dong Yang) with Suzhou University of Science and Technology and BIT (Nan Xiao)
versions: 2022 strain-gauge catheter bending recognition (wei2022_intravascular, abstract); 2022 vascular environment identification (yang2022_vascular, title); 2023 multi-data detection robot (yang2023_interventional, abstract + figures)
target_anatomy: N.R. (DSA of cerebral vessels shown in the system schematic)
devices_driven: catheter and guidewire (separate clamping modules, yang2023_interventional Fig. 2 labels)
force_sensing: distal thin-film force sensor in the catheter head (insect-antenna inspired) + pressure sensor in the catheter clamping device (2023); strain gauges on the catheter (2022)
haptics_leader: master with two knobs and touchscreen (yang2023_interventional Fig. 1); force feedback N.R.
validation_detail: vessel-model tests for environment classification (counts N.R. in the abstracts)
key_numbers: LSTM vascular-environment classification accuracy 94.2% (yang2023_interventional abstract); GA-optimised BP network reduces bending-recognition error by 37% (wei2022_intravascular abstract); EtherCAT motion control (Fig. 1)
